reason: I'd take the free 15-company list, it costs me nothing, but I wouldn't pay the 1,600 this month. My partner will ask who these people are, and one logistics client with 45 meetings isn't enough proof for him. Next to that, Apollo plus a junior SDR feels like something we'd own and control.
objection: The proof is one case study with no name, and the 90-day refund depends on us arguing over what counts as qualified. I don't want to spend three months chasing a refund from an agency I've never heard of, and then have my partner say I told you so.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 has companies we didn't know about and that clearly fit, and I can call one or two of their wholesale or distribution clients in our region, I'd take the pilot to my partner.
